Anne Callanan In 1847 on 17 May at 5 p.m. appeared before me, Adolfsche Fischer, mayor and civil registrar in Hollerich :
Nicolas Mertens, 42 years old, gardener, residing in Kreuzgrüdchen, who showed us a female child born at 10 this morning to himself and his wife Marguerite nee Metzler, 38 years old, without profession. He wants to name the child Marie.
Witnesses :
Mathais Badry, 35 years old, day labourer residing in Merl,
and Andre Klein, day labourer, 25 years old, residing in Merl.
The father, witnesses and myself have signed this act.
